This page lists figures in English Wikipedia articles that cite a [https://data.worldbank.org World Bank] series, where the series now says something different. It was generated 2026-09-26 by [https://github.com/jhaney0214-sys/freshcite freshcite] 0.1.0, which read 1270 articles and 2730 World Bank citations, and reported 364.

'''Nothing here has been edited.''' Each row gives the sentence as it reads, the figure as written, and what the cited series says today; each is for an editor to judge. A figure that is right for the year it states is never listed, and neither is anything the tool could not match to one year of the series. Please note in the last column what you did, or why the row is wrong.

World Bank data is [https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/legal/terms-of-use-for-datasets CC BY 4.0].
